newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kaneko Seed to take over plant wholesaler.
newsitem.headline: Kaneko Seed to take over plant wholesaler.

text.p: Kaneko Seed Co Ltd said on Monday it will take over Nakajima Engei KK, a wholesaler of plants and gardening goods, on December 1.
Under the takeover scheme, every four shares of Nakajima Engei will be exchanged for one share of Kaneko Seed, Kaneko said in a statement.

After the takeover, Kaneko expects sales to increase to 40 billion yen and current profit to 980 million yen in the year to May 1998, rising further to 43 billion yen and 1.1 billion yen respectively in 1999/20.
